4 result(s) across 21st.dev (metadata only).

### [component] Navbar Section 2  [id: 18120]
by solaceui
A dark navigation bar with an animated expanding mega-menu dropdown and a light hero section, inspired by the xAI marketing layout.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/solaceui/navbar-section-2/default/preview.1783575304015.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/solaceui/navbar-section-2?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 18120 })

### [component] Navbar 1   [id: 2046]
by preetsuthar17
Floating animated and responsive navbar component

install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/preetsuthar17/navbar-1?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"

### [component] Navbar  [id: 24316]
by rizwanasghar1997
A modern style animated navbar with full fledge mega menu and a flare moving on border of the navbar
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/rizwanasghar1997/navbar/default/preview.1786096625476-5e9b5f60-ec84-4cdf-9b54-701697097bd7.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/rizwanasghar1997/navbar?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 24316 })

### [component] Navbar 5  [id: 2307]
by shadcnblockscom
Shadcn Navbar with 2 column dropdown menus and mobile menu that slides in from the top with dropdowns
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/shadcnblockscom/navbar-5/default/preview.1747815725934.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/shadcnblockscom/navbar-5?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 2307 })

Metadata is free. get_component (the code) is the PAID step - on the free tier it uses your daily retrieval quota (see get_usage).
